ideas.pitch: A predictive risk modeling dashboard built for student organizations and event planners to forecast safety, logistical, or compliance incidents at large on-campus gatherings using Poisson regression and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: Princeton Local Campus AI Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning formula of bringing rigorous, non-trivial statistical forecasting (Poisson GAM) to a domain that usually relies on guesswork, matching past successful AI forecasting projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool configured for Princeton township zoning laws to automatically track land use compliance, illegal dumping, and environmental changes using multi-modal geospatial vision models.
ideas.title: Township GreenCompliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard computer vision engineering with local municipal utility, directly mirroring the satellite monitoring and industrial compliance winner from Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app tailored specifically to Princeton High School and local student dietary constraints that scans cafeteria menus and generates personalized micronutrient optimization and weekly meal plans.
ideas.title: DiningHall AI Nutrition & Micro-Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an intensely relatable hyper-local problem with immediate user value, echoing the rapid prototyping success of the 24-hour nutrition assistant hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent collaboration platform powered by LangGraph and RAG that helps high school club presidents automate event scheduling, permission slip tracking, and member communications.
ideas.title: ClubOS Multi-Agent Student Organization Support Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes advanced agentic workflows and RAG architecture which proved successful in winning student support hackathon categories.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered trust and matching platform designed for student-run tutoring networks to optimize peer discovery, build verifiable credibility profiles, and streamline intake.
ideas.title: PeerTutor Trust & Patient Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on trust-building and acquisition loops in a constrained marketplace, following the exact mechanics of the Elevate X prize-winning patient acquisition engine.
